acceptance: Extend bounded local trace queries with filters for task-derived session name, local session ID, trace ID, call ID, worker role, task revision/attempt, outcome, phase, and bounded time range.
Provide a bounded correlation summary for delegated parent/child and retry relationships while preserving unavailable and malformed evidence states.
Keep exact-ID Pi session detail, ownership scope, paging, limits, and privacy projection compatible; conversational and tool payloads remain behind explicit exact-session selectors.
Add provider-free fixtures for multi-field retrieval, relationship/retry summaries, malformed or unavailable evidence, privacy, and bounded output.
